cues: From alkanes, by free radical halogenation in ultraviolet light.
Light splits a chlorine molecule into two radicals, initiation.
A chlorine radical pulls a hydrogen off methane, making a methyl radical, which grabs chlorine and releases a new chlorine radical.
That loop, propagation, repeats thousands of times.
It ends when two radicals meet, termination.
